source_id: AFR-DEPT-001 Eligible publishers (CFR-DEPT-001)
preconditions: One authenticated Faculty member, Dept_Admin and HOD in the department
action_or_input: Have each actor create and publish a distinct targeted announcement
expected_result: Each actor's announcement is published with its selected audience

source_id: AFR-DEPT-046 Publication notifications (CFR-DEPT-001)
preconditions: A new announcement targets both Student and Faculty audiences, with matching and nonmatching users in each
action_or_input: Publish the announcement and check recipients
expected_result: Matching Students and Faculty receive the publication notification and users outside the target do not

source_id: AFR-DEPT-002 All three audience filters (CFR-DEPT-002)
preconditions: A published announcement and otherwise comparable viewers differing individually in role, program or academic year
action_or_input: Read the announcement as a full match and as each single-dimension mismatch
expected_result: The full match can see it and each mismatch cannot

source_id: AFR-DEPT-003 Relevant announcement access (CFR-DEPT-002)
preconditions: An authenticated department user and a published announcement relevant to that user
action_or_input: Open the announcement feed
expected_result: The relevant announcement is visible to the user

source_id: AFR-DEPT-004 HOD edits an active announcement (CFR-DEPT-003)
preconditions: An active department announcement published by another eligible user
action_or_input: Have the HOD change its content
expected_result: The active announcement reflects the HOD's change

source_id: AFR-DEPT-005 HOD hides an active announcement (CFR-DEPT-003)
preconditions: An active announcement visible to a matching user
action_or_input: Have the HOD hide the announcement and check the matching user's feed
expected_result: The announcement is hidden from the matching user

source_id: AFR-DEPT-006 HOD deletes an active announcement (CFR-DEPT-003)
preconditions: An active announcement published by another eligible user
action_or_input: Have the HOD delete the announcement
expected_result: The deleted announcement is no longer available as an active announcement

source_id: AFR-DEPT-007 Department stock insertion (CFR-DEPT-004)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and a stock item to add to the department
action_or_input: Insert a stock record with a known quantity
expected_result: The stock record exists in the department inventory

source_id: AFR-DEPT-008 Current quantity is maintained (CFR-DEPT-004)
preconditions: An inventory item with an initial quantity and a valid stock insertion for that item
action_or_input: Record the insertion and read the current inventory state
expected_result: The current item quantity reflects the known addition

source_id: AFR-DEPT-014 Immutable insertion log (CFR-DEPT-004)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin able to insert stock
action_or_input: Insert stock, inspect the resulting movement and attempt to alter or remove that movement
expected_result: An insertion movement records the item and quantity and persists unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-009 Faculty submits a request (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty member and a department inventory item with sufficient stock
action_or_input: Submit a stock request
expected_result: The request is accepted for HOD approval

source_id: AFR-DEPT-010 Request quantity equal to availability (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An item with a positive available quantity and an eligible Faculty requester
action_or_input: Request exactly the quantity currently available
expected_result: The quantity check accepts the request for approval

source_id: AFR-DEPT-010 Request quantity above availability (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An item with a known positive available quantity and an eligible Faculty requester
action_or_input: Request one more than the available quantity
expected_result: The request does not proceed to HOD approval and inventory stays unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-011 Both HOD decisions (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: Two distinct requests pending HOD decision
action_or_input: Have the HOD approve one and reject the other
expected_result: The selected requests reach Approved and Rejected respectively

source_id: AFR-DEPT-012 Approved issuance (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: A stock request already approved by the HOD and a Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Have the Dept_Admin issue the requested item
expected_result: The request reaches Issued

source_id: AFR-DEPT-012 Issuance requires prior approval (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: A pending request, a rejected request and a Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Attempt to issue each unapproved request
expected_result: Both attempts are refused and neither request nor inventory changes

source_id: AFR-DEPT-013 Issuance deducts the requested quantity (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An approved request for a known quantity and an inventory balance sufficient for issue
action_or_input: Have the Dept_Admin issue the stock and read the balance
expected_result: The balance decreases by the issued quantity

source_id: AFR-DEPT-015 Immutable issuance log (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An approved stock request that can be issued
action_or_input: Issue stock, inspect the movement and attempt to alter or remove it
expected_result: An issuance movement records the item and quantity and persists unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-041 New request alerts Dept_Admin (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: An eligible Faculty requester, available stock and the department's Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Submit a new stock request
expected_result: The Dept_Admin receives a notification about the new request

source_id: AFR-DEPT-042 Approval request alerts HOD (CFR-DEPT-005)
preconditions: The department has a HOD and the Faculty requester can submit a valid stock request
action_or_input: Submit a request that proceeds to HOD authorization
expected_result: The HOD receives a notification about the request requiring authorization

source_id: AFR-DEPT-043 Requester receives both kinds of final outcome (CFR-DEPT-005)
purpose: Requester receives both kinds of final outcome
preconditions: One request ready to issue and one request pending rejection, with known Faculty requesters
action_or_input: Issue the approved request and have the HOD reject the other
expected_result: Each requesting Faculty member receives the notification for their own final outcome

source_id: AFR-DEPT-016 Faculty issued history is relevant (CFR-DEPT-006)
preconditions: Two Faculty members with distinct issued items and a pending request for one member
action_or_input: Open issued-stock history as that Faculty member
expected_result: The relevant issued item appears, and the other Faculty member's item and pending request are absent

source_id: AFR-DEPT-017 Both feedback submitter roles (CFR-DEPT-007)
preconditions: An authenticated department Student and Faculty member
action_or_input: Submit distinct feedback as each actor
expected_result: Both submissions are accepted

source_id: AFR-DEPT-018 Feedback remains confidential (CFR-DEPT-007)
preconditions: A submitted feedback item, an authorized handler and a user outside the authorized handling scope
action_or_input: Attempt to read it as each user
expected_result: The authorized handler can read it and the outside user cannot retrieve its confidential content

source_id: AFR-DEPT-044 New feedback alerts Dept_Admin (CFR-DEPT-007)
preconditions: An eligible feedback submitter and the department's Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Submit feedback
expected_result: The Dept_Admin receives a notification about the submission

source_id: AFR-DEPT-019 Initial feedback review (CFR-DEPT-008)
preconditions: New feedback awaiting review and a Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Perform the initial review as the Dept_Admin
expected_result: The feedback leaves the unreviewed state and records completed initial review

source_id: AFR-DEPT-020 Initial review categorization (CFR-DEPT-008)
preconditions: New feedback and a permitted category
action_or_input: Have the Dept_Admin categorize the item during initial review
expected_result: The selected category is retained on the reviewed item

source_id: AFR-DEPT-021 Close a simple issue during initial review (CFR-DEPT-008)
purpose: Close a simple issue during initial review
preconditions: Unreviewed feedback considered a simple issue
action_or_input: Have the Dept_Admin review and close it in the initial review
expected_result: The item reaches Closed through that initial review

source_id: AFR-DEPT-022 Both reviewers can reach both terminal states (CFR-DEPT-008)
purpose: Both reviewers can reach both terminal states
preconditions: Distinct feedback items with Dept_Admin initial review complete
action_or_input: Have the Dept_Admin resolve one and close another and have the HOD resolve and close two others
expected_result: Each supported action reaches its selected terminal state

source_id: AFR-DEPT-022 HOD terminal action requires initial review (CFR-DEPT-008)
purpose: HOD terminal action requires initial review
preconditions: New feedback with no Dept_Admin initial review
action_or_input: Have the HOD attempt to resolve it and attempt to close it
expected_result: Neither terminal action takes effect and the item remains unreviewed

source_id: AFR-DEPT-023 HOD oversight starts after initial review (CFR-DEPT-008)
purpose: HOD oversight starts after initial review
preconditions: New feedback and the department's HOD and Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Check HOD access before and after Dept_Admin initial review
expected_result: The HOD cannot access the item before review and can access it afterward

source_id: AFR-DEPT-045 Submitter notified on resolution and closure (CFR-DEPT-008)
purpose: Submitter notified on resolution and closure
preconditions: Two reviewed items with known submitters
action_or_input: Resolve one item and close the other through supported review actions
expected_result: Each submitter receives a notification of their item's terminal outcome

source_id: AFR-DEPT-024 Department profile management (CFR-DEPT-009)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and Faculty, Student and Alumni profiles within the department

expected_result: Each authorized update persists on the intended profile

source_id: AFR-DEPT-024 Management stays within the department (CFR-DEPT-009)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and a profile in a different department

source_id: AFR-DEPT-025 Student profile visibility is basic (CFR-DEPT-010)
preconditions: A Student viewer, a peer Student and a Faculty profile containing both basic and non-basic fields under the applicable policy

purpose: Faculty sees detailed profiles for Students in their courses
preconditions: A Faculty viewer and an enrolled Student whose profile has permitted detailed fields
action_or_input: Read the Student profile as the Faculty member
expected_result: Detailed permitted profile information is visible

source_id: AFR-DEPT-026 Detailed access is scoped to the Faculty course relationship (CFR-DEPT-010)
purpose: Detailed access is scoped to the Faculty course relationship
preconditions: A Faculty viewer and a Student outside that Faculty member's courses
action_or_input: Attempt to retrieve the same detailed profile information
expected_result: Course-scoped detailed information is withheld

source_id: AFR-DEPT-027 Faculty and Alumni visibility is limited (CFR-DEPT-010)
purpose: Faculty and Alumni visibility is limited
preconditions: A Faculty viewer and Faculty and Alumni profiles containing limited-scope fields and fields outside that scope
action_or_input: Read both profiles as the Faculty member
expected_result: Each view is limited to its permitted fields

source_id: AFR-DEPT-028 Full department view excludes protected data (CFR-DEPT-010)
purpose: Full department view excludes protected data
preconditions: HOD and Dept_Admin viewers and department profiles containing permitted and policy-protected fields
action_or_input: Read the department profiles as each role
expected_result: Both roles receive the full permitted profile and no protected sensitive fields

source_id: AFR-DEPT-029 Upload class and lab timetables (CFR-DEPT-011)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and valid conflict-free class and lab timetable entries
action_or_input: Upload both kinds of timetable
expected_result: Both sets of entries are saved

source_id: AFR-DEPT-030 Modify class and lab timetables (CFR-DEPT-011)
preconditions: Existing class and lab timetable entries and a Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Make a conflict-free modification to each kind
expected_result: Both modifications are saved

source_id: AFR-DEPT-031 Block overlapping timetable uploads (CFR-DEPT-011)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and an upload containing overlapping slots
action_or_input: Attempt the upload and inspect the timetable afterward
expected_result: The conflict is detected and no conflicting upload is saved

source_id: AFR-DEPT-031 Block overlapping timetable edits (CFR-DEPT-011)
preconditions: An existing valid timetable and an edit that overlaps another slot
action_or_input: Attempt the edit and reload the timetable
expected_result: The edit is refused and the saved timetable remains unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-034 Update lab resource details (CFR-DEPT-012)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and a department lab profile with equipment and resource details
action_or_input: Update the equipment and resource details
expected_result: The changed details are retained on the lab profile

source_id: AFR-DEPT-035 Faculty can view lab profiles (CFR-DEPT-012)
preconditions: A Faculty member and department lab profiles with known resource details
action_or_input: Open the lab resource profiles as Faculty
expected_result: The resource profiles and their details are available for planning

source_id: AFR-DEPT-036 Student academic program information (CFR-DEPT-013)
preconditions: A Student and department academic program information
action_or_input: Open department academic program information as the Student
expected_result: The department's program information is visible

source_id: AFR-DEPT-037 Applicable Student timetable (CFR-DEPT-013)
preconditions: A Student and applicable class and lab timetable entries
action_or_input: Open the timetable as the Student
expected_result: Applicable class and lab entries are visible

source_id: AFR-DEPT-038 General department detail update (CFR-DEPT-014)
preconditions: A Dept_Admin and a non-official department detail
action_or_input: Update the general detail and reload published department information
expected_result: The updated general information is visible

source_id: AFR-DEPT-039 Pending official detail stays unpublished (CFR-DEPT-015)
preconditions: A current official detail and a Dept_Admin with a proposed value for an independently editable official field
action_or_input: Submit the proposal, then inspect both the pending change and published detail before HOD decision
expected_result: The proposal is pending and the published detail retains the current value

source_id: AFR-DEPT-040 Approved official change becomes effective (CFR-DEPT-015)
preconditions: A pending official-detail proposal and the HOD
action_or_input: Approve the proposal and reload the department detail
expected_result: The proposal is approved and its official value becomes effective

source_id: AFR-DEPT-040 Rejected official change retains current data (CFR-DEPT-015)
purpose: Rejected official change retains current data
preconditions: A pending official-detail proposal and an existing published value
action_or_input: Have the HOD reject the proposal and reload the department detail
expected_result: The proposal is rejected and the published value remains unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-047 Central authority assigns both department roles (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Central authority assigns both department roles
preconditions: An authorized Institute Admin, eligible institute employees and a department
action_or_input: Have the central authority assign the HOD and Dept_Admin roles according to the validity rules
expected_result: Each eligible employee holds the intended department role during its active interval

source_id: AFR-DEPT-047 Department roles require central assignment authority (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Department roles require central assignment authority
preconditions: A department actor without central assignment authority and existing valid role assignments
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or reassign either role as that actor
expected_result: The assignments are refused and existing role holders stay unchanged

source_id: AFR-DEPT-048 Each assignment has a validity interval (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Each assignment has a validity interval
preconditions: Scheduled successor HOD and Dept_Admin assignments with an effective start and end and valid neighboring assignments
action_or_input: Inspect each role's effective holder before, during and after the successor's validity interval
expected_result: Each successor is active only during its validity interval

source_id: AFR-DEPT-049 Revoke outgoing access at the effective transition (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Revoke outgoing access at the effective transition
preconditions: An outgoing HOD and Dept_Admin with scheduled successor assignments and known role-specific operations
action_or_input: Exercise each outgoing holder's department-role access immediately before and at the effective transition
expected_result: The outgoing holders have the role access before the transition and lose it when the transition takes effect

source_id: AFR-DEPT-050 Grant incoming access at the effective transition (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Grant incoming access at the effective transition
preconditions: Incoming HOD and Dept_Admin with scheduled assignments and no other grant of the tested role-specific operations
action_or_input: Exercise each incoming holder's department-role access immediately before and at the effective transition
expected_result: Incoming holders lack the role access before the transition and gain it when the transition takes effect

source_id: AFR-DEPT-051 Exactly one active HOD (CFR-DEPT-016)
preconditions: A department with one valid active HOD and a central authority
action_or_input: Attempt a second simultaneous HOD and an update that would leave a gap before the successor
expected_result: Neither attempt can leave the department with two or zero active HODs

source_id: AFR-DEPT-052 Exactly one active Dept_Admin (CFR-DEPT-016)
preconditions: A department with one valid active Dept_Admin and a central authority
action_or_input: Attempt a second simultaneous Dept_Admin and an update that would leave a gap before the successor
expected_result: Neither attempt can leave the department with two or zero active Dept_Admins

source_id: AFR-DEPT-053 Displayed Headship follows effective HOD (CFR-DEPT-016)
preconditions: The department has a current HOD and a scheduled HOD successor
action_or_input: Read displayed Headship before and at the effective transition
expected_result: Displayed Headship identifies the current HOD before the transition and the successor when the assignment takes effect

source_id: AFR-DEPT-053 Headship cannot be independently edited as an official detail (CFR-DEPT-016)
purpose: Headship cannot be independently edited as an official detail
preconditions: An active HOD assignment and a Dept_Admin authorized to propose independent official details
action_or_input: Attempt to propose a different Headship through the official-detail change process
